reading.performance.advice_main_idea: Focus on the opening paragraph and the first sentence of each paragraph to practice summarizing the main idea.
reading.performance.advice_detail: Practice locating details in the passage and watch for keywords like time, place and people in the question.
reading.performance.advice_inference: Make reasonable inferences from context clues, paying attention to the author's attitude and implied meaning.
reading.performance.advice_word_guess: Guess word meaning from roots, affixes and context, and build up common word-formation patterns.
reading.performance.advice_attitude: Watch the adjectives and adverbs the author uses to express attitude, and note the tone.
reading.performance.advice_fact_opinion: Learn to separate objective facts from subjective opinions and notice opinion-bearing words.
reading.performance.advice_structure: Outline the text structure and watch for transitions and logical relations between paragraphs.
reading.performance.advice_paragraph_mai: Practice summarizing each paragraph's topic sentence and how supporting sentences back it up.
reading.performance.advice_causality: Watch for causal connectors (because/therefore/due to) and sort out cause-and-effect relations.
reading.performance.advice_grammar_fill: Review grammar points systematically (tense/voice/clauses/non-finite verbs) and analyze sentence structure in context.
reading.performance.praise_main_idea: You grasp the main idea accurately and quickly capture the core of the passage.
reading.performance.praise_detail: You locate details accurately and understand specific information well.
reading.performance.praise_inference: Excellent inference skills — you pick up implied information from context.
reading.performance.praise_word_guess: Great word-guessing skills — you flexibly use word formation and context clues.
reading.performance.praise_attitude: Accurate reading of attitude — you keenly sense the author's stance.
reading.performance.praise_fact_opinion: You clearly distinguish facts from opinions, showing strong critical thinking.
reading.performance.praise_structure: You grasp the text structure well and can follow the line of argument.
reading.performance.praise_paragraph_mai: You summarize paragraph ideas accurately and capture each paragraph's core.
reading.performance.praise_causality: You understand cause and effect thoroughly and follow the logic chain precisely.
reading.performance.praise_grammar_fill: Solid grammar skills — you apply grammar rules accurately in real contexts.
